notes: Round 1 disassembly. Inputs use NES emulator.input {buttons:[...],port:1} (each call replaces held set; see TK-001). Frame steps use emulator.step unit=frame with max_operations=100000000. Tracing (aggregates, capacity 0) runs ~3 fps vs ~40 fps untraced, so navigation was done untraced and traced windows were used in each new state. Named snapshots were session-local and are not persisted; routes below are replayable from power-on. Round 2: emulator.run_until is limited to <=1,000,000 operations and timeout_ms<=30000 per call (loop it). In 2-player mode player 2 prompts read controller port 2. Round 2 redirect r2-a1: S13b, S14 added; all listed milestones visited; no high-score name entry exists; ending S10 visited.
